content: It includes detailed citations of research papers, reviews, and clinical studies related to topics such as post-laryngectomy complications, swallowing disorders, voice rehabilitation, neck dissection outcomes, cancer-related fatigue, depression, smoking effects, and quality of life in cancer patients. Each reference is formatted with the authors' names, article titles, journal names, publication dates, volume and issue numbers, and page ranges. These references are essential for understanding the breadth of research conducted in these areas and provide a foundation for further exploration of the topics mentioned.
